# Rishav Dahal

> Portfolio, technical research, and system engineering blogs by Rishav Dahal — CTO at DLPlatforms and Backend & DevOps Engineer specializing in scalable cloud systems, high-availability APIs, distributed architectures, and AI/CV systems.

## Key Skills & Tech Stack
- Languages: Python, Go (Golang), C++, JavaScript (ES6+), PHP, SQL, Bash
- Frameworks & Libraries: FastAPI, Django REST Framework, Docker, OpenCV, Dlib, PyTorch, NLTK, Scikit-Learn
- Cloud & DevOps: Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), Nginx, AWS, Cloudflare, Linux System Administration
- Architectures: Microservices, Distributed Systems, High-Concurrency Web APIs, Event-Driven Architectures, Topic Modeling (LDA), Real-time Computer Vision

## Featured Projects
- [Cast in Nepal](https://www.rishavdahal.com.np/cast-in-Nepal/): Algorithmic cultural matching, genealogical relationship analysis, and search engine across thousands of Nepalese surnames and lineages.
- [Modular Query Refinement](https://www.rishavdahal.com.np/projects/modular-query-refinement/): Research publication (ICICSET 2025) introducing LDA Topic Modeling and semantic term extraction for search relevance optimization.
- [Payment Gateway Orchestrator](https://www.rishavdahal.com.np/blogs/fastapi-payment-gateway-orchestrator/): Resilient, idempotent multi-provider payment router built with FastAPI and Redis.
- [Real-Time Face Recognition Attendance](https://www.rishavdahal.com.np/blogs/real-time-face-recognition-dlib-opencv/): High-throughput biometric face detection pipeline with OpenCV and Dlib.
